desc: Derive the initial inversion-count computation with a Fenwick tree, treating equal values as non-inversions.
Derive and implement the aggregated transition delta `2*S - t*(N-1)` for each wrapping residue group.
Validate the algorithm on all public samples and relevant edge cases.
Maintain `O(N log M + N + M)` time and `O(N + M)` memory.
